scenes.title: Key ideas
items: TVL can double count and moves with token prices.
scenes.vo: First, T.V.L. can double count and moves with token prices. Next, Depth: the price impact for a given trade size. The number that matters for execution. Then, Volume/T.V.L.: rough capital turnover; higher means more fees per dollar (Lesson 2.3). And finally, Liquidity migration: incentives move liquidity quickly between pools and chains.
